title: Boat-based whale watching with Southern Right Charters
summary: An informative and educational boat-based whale watching trip from Hermanus New Harbour, with daily departures during the peak whale season from June to end November, weather permitting.
description: Join Southern Right Charters for an informative and educational whale watching experience. Times: 06h30, 09h00, 12h00 & 15h00. Daily Departures, weather permitting. Check-in is strictly 30 minutes prior to departure time for check-in & on-land introductory briefing. 2026 Whale Watching rates: Adults R1 580, Students | Seniors R1 480, Children (under 12) R790, Children (under 3) FREE. Duration 1h30 – 3 hrs, average 2 hours. The whale watching experience begins with an on-land briefing led by our whale specialist guide. We then set off from the Hermanus New Harbour in search of the ‘gentle giants.’ The peak Hermanus whale watching season typically runs from June to end November. Whale Species: Southern Right (Jun-Dec), Humpback (June-September) & Bryde’s whales (all year). Purpose-built catamaran, MV Miroshca. Sighting Guarantee: 50% Refund or Join us again, free.
openingHours: Daily departures at 06h30, 09h00, 12h00 & 15h00, weather permitting; check-in 30 minutes before departure
profile: A guided boat trip from Hermanus New Harbour on a purpose-built catamaran to watch southern right and humpback whales, with daily departures from June to the end of November. Passengers get an on-land briefing, then spend about two hours at sea with a whale specialist guide and may also see dolphins, seals and seabirds. It suits visitors of all ages during whale season, with child, student and senior rates.
